title: Finite site comparison preserves counit and projection transposes
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient datum [def-pur-conventions]: $k$ is the fixed algebraic closure of a finite field of characteristic $p$, $\ell\ne p$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite, $n\ge1$, and $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type morphism of finite-type $k$-schemes, with chosen compactification $c=(j:X\hookrightarrow\overline X,r:\overline X\to Y)$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Absolute separatedness is not required. Use constant-$A$ module derived categories on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], $C_T=\nu_T^*$ [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism, def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback], $F_f^e=Rr_{e,*}j_!^e$, $F_f^p=Rr_{p,*}j_!^p$, and the specified comparison $B_f:C_YF_f^e\xrightarrow{\sim}F_f^pC_X$ [lem-pur-compact-support-site-coherence]. Let $G_f^e$ be the ordinary-etale right adjoint [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint], and $G_f^p=Rf^!$ the finite transported exceptional inverse image [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Use the specified pullback, coefficient-unit and tensor comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback, lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback].

On bounded etale inputs with bounded constructible finite-Tor images, the canonical comparison $a_{f,K}:C_XG_f^eK\xrightarrow{\sim}G_f^pC_YK$ induced by the site-comparison unit $K\xrightarrow{\sim}R\nu_{Y,*}C_YK$ (the map $\rho_K$ of [lem-pur-bounded-site-adjunction-transpose]) preserves exceptional counits:
$$\varepsilon^p_{f,C_YK}\circ F_f^p(a_{f,K})\circ B_{f,G_f^eK}=C_Y(\varepsilon^e_{f,K}).$$
For $M\in D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $K\in D^b_{ctf}(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, let $P^e_{f,M,K}$ be the proper counit-mate projection [def-kun-projection-formula-map] followed by the open tensor comparison [lem-pur-etale-open-derived-tensor], and let $P^p_{f,C_XM,C_YK}$ be exactly the compactification projection of [def-exchange-projection]; use ordinary derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor] and the finite-Tor category [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. After the specified tensor/pullback identifications,
$$ B_{f,M\otimes f^*K}\circ C_Y(P^e_{f,M,K})=P^p_{f,C_XM,C_YK}\circ(B_{f,M}\otimes1_{C_YK}). $$
Consequently the counit-transpose tensor map $\theta^e_{f,K}$, defined as the adjunct of tensor symmetry followed by $(P^e)^{-1}$ and $\varepsilon^e_{f,A}\otimes1_K$, is carried to the specified $\theta^p_{f,C_YK}$ of [def-pur-co-smoothness]. Here inverse projections are used only on their finite-Tor domains where they are isomorphisms. The same adjunction comparison carries the right-adjoint conjugates of compact-support compositors and the counit transposes of compact-support exchanges to the specified pro-etale ones. These identifications preserve identities, refinement, composition, Cartesian base change and further compatible open restriction on bounded-below etale-origin inputs. Every bounded constructible pro-etale input admits an etale origin, and equality of maps between such inputs is reflected by $C_T$; the identifications are independent of that origin.

proof.text: Extract the lower cohomological endpoint from bounded constructibility. Extract both endpoints for boundedness, and use Etale.plus_derivedTensor_leftDerivedUpperStar with the finite-Tor hypothesis to bound the tensor input. This is the boundedness argument already used in the finite compact projection theorem.

Apply compact_projection_square, the proved generic finite-ring helper of projectionComparison_etaleOrigin, at the actual lifted coefficient ring P.Coefficient and the two bounded-below witnesses. It is exactly the required forward projection square, without any coefficient transport. The proved generic helper finiteCompactProjection_etale gives invertibility of the etale projection. Extract boundedness and the finite Tor interval, extend by zero, and use the existing hasProjectionFormulaOfCompactification_of_comparison theorem and the finite proper projection formula to prove invertibility of the actual pro-etale projection.

Apply exists_topologicalKrullDim_le to c.g followed by aY. This includes the empty compactification. With that dimension certificate, boundedSiteAdjunctionTranspose gives the counit equation and every compatible transpose exactly as stated.

For the normalized tensor maps apply the proved private categorical lemma normalizedProjectionPair. Its etale member is the inverse etale projection followed by the counit-tensor composite; its pro-etale member is the specified compact-support comparison followed by the image of the etale member. The forward projection square is rotated across the tensor and input comparison isomorphisms to give the second normalization. Cancellation by the etale projection and by the pro-etale projection followed by the inverse input comparison proves uniqueness. boundedSiteTranspose_compatible gives the final equation. For the named theta, the existing proof applies that same helper directly to the inverse etale adjunct of theta. No additional hypotheses on exceptional images are introduced.

The diagram clause of compactSupportSiteCoherence gives C(D_e) b1=b0 D_p. Cancel b1 and the source compact-support comparison, then use functoriality to identify the composite with C(e D_e z). Apply the compatible-transpose helper of boundedSiteAdjunctionTranspose. This treats every generated identity, refinement, composition, push, pull and boundary change diagram in the existing inductive diagram type.

Evaluate compactSupport_exchange_transport at L, cancel its target comparison and the initial compact-support comparison, and apply the compatible-transpose helper to C(e E_e z). The arbitrary-origin component is invertible by the existing bounded-etale-origin compact-support base-change theorem; transport the origin property across alpha. The witness equation is the second clause of compactSupport_exchange_transport. No hypothesis on the horizontal base-change arrow is introduced.

The existing fixed-module derived Hom bijection reflects equality and uniquely lifts the transition alpha followed by alpha-prime inverse between origins. Naturality of any supplied transformation at the origin isomorphism and cancellation of its image prove independence of transported maps. For existence of origins, finite type over the field makes T Noetherian. Apply exceptionalTransport_constructible_comparison to the stated boundedness and intrinsic fixed-module constructibility, then equip its bounded constructible etale representative with the lower endpoint already proved.
